messages:
leah-hr: Hey all ":wave:" Mika's start is next Tuesday. Need to confirm I-9 path (prefers notary), background check status, and expense process for notary fee. Can we align?
rina-recruiter: Mika told me they'd rather pay the notary upfront and get reimbursed. We reimburse via Expense with receipt. I'll DM the reimbursement steps.
omar-it: FYI on access: if hardware isn't delivered by day 1 we'll provide an RDP cloud image. Laptop imaging 24-48h after ticket. Need shipping address ASAP.
mika-newhire: Hi team ":raised_hand:" I can do the mobile notary Fri afternoon. Shipping address is 302 Elm St, Unit 7. I don't need a dock.
leah-hr: Notary is fine. HR needs the notarized I-9 plus a photo ID scan for records. I'll send the secure upload link. Also note: if the notary charges >$50, submit an expense with a short note and tag "onboarding-notary".
rina-recruiter: Also remind Mika to keep the original documents until we confirm. Some notaries only make certified copies.
omar-it: Creating ticket IT-2044 now. Tagging "expedite-shipping". If Mika needs VPN day 1 we should try to provision SSO groups early but MFA must be set first.
mika-newhire: Got it. One quick Q: will I get benefits info before day 1? I want to compare plans.
leah-hr: We'll pre-send a benefits snapshot PDF and a short FAQ. Full BenAdmin email arrives on day 1 automatically but you can preview now.
onboard-bot: "Reminder: Day 1 orientation scheduled Tue 09:30-12:00 PT. Onboarding checklist created for mika-newhire." (automated)
rina-recruiter: Action items:
- rina-recruiter: submit reimbursement instructions to Mika (today)
- omar-it: create IT-2044, attempt expedited imaging + VPN on day 1 (today)
- mika-newhire: book notary Fri, upload notarized I-9 + ID scan to portal (due Fri)
- leah-hr: send benefits snapshot and upload link (today)

mika-newhire: Booked notary Fri 3pm and uploaded the ID scan. I saved the receipt for reimbursement.
leah-hr: K, I see the upload. Reimbursement approved once receipt is in Expensify. Omar, please confirm shipping ETA.
omar-it: Laptop shipped overnight. Tracking: UPS 1ZABC... ETA Mon morning. Ticket moved to In Progress.
leah-hr: Great. If BG check stalls, I'll escalate after 4 business days. Closing loop here; ping this thread with any issues. :thumbsup:
